title: Manga Creator Tsukasa Sei Dies
content: Manga creator Tsukasa Sei died on November 17. Sei's official X (formerly Twitter ) account announced the death on November 20. Sei launched the Mukashi wa Yokatta (It Was Good Back Then) manga in Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ app in February 2023, and ended it in September of that year.

title: Witch on the Holy Night Film Expands 981 Cuts for ScreenX Release
content: The official website for the Witch on the Holy Night ( Mahōtsukai no Yoru ) anime film announced on Sunday that the film will begin playing in the premium formats ScreenX, Ultra 4DX, Dolby Cinema, 4DX, and MX4D in Japan this Friday, November 27.

title: 3 Anime to Watch If You Love Sword Art Online
content: It’s been more than six years since Sword Art Online released its second season, and the next installment is going to be its anticipated feature-length movie. However, the movie will only be released in 2028, and fans in the U.S. will have to wait even longer for its global premiere.
